name: kernel-workbench
displayName: Kernel Workbench: Configure, Build, Run, Debug
description: Visual Studio-style Configure / Build / Run / Debug for the Linux kernel: a Kernel panel and editor toolbar with arch, Debug/Release and config; QEMU + gdb; clangd set up automatically. No per-workspace files.

kernelWorkbench.arch.description: Default architecture for trees where none was picked. Empty: the host architecture.

kernelWorkbench.variant.description: Default build variant for trees where none was picked.

kernelWorkbench.configure.defconfig.markdownDescription: Default base config: one or more make targets (`defconfig`, `defconfig kvm_guest.config`, `tinyconfig`) or a path to a `.config` file. A base config picked for an architecture overrides it.

kernelWorkbench.buildDirectory.markdownDescription: Build output (`O=`), relative to the kernel tree or absolute. `${arch}` and `${variant}` are substituted.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && node --test out/test/integration/kernelTree.integration.js && vscode-test --label mainline-kernel
